answer_1.quote: Text style transfer aims to convert the text into a target style while preserving the content of the source text ...

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation metrics include the follows: ACC measures how accurately the model transfer the text style. BLEU compares the gold reference and transferred text ... PPL is used to measure the fluency of the transferred text. G‑mean is the geometric mean of BLEU and ACC.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to more flexibly and comprehensively evaluate the models. ... annotators are asked to score the generated text in the range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each output on style transfer strength, content preservation and fluency using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
